code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows pancytopenia (low leukocytes, neutrophils, lymphocytes, platelets), elevated monocytes, basophils, ferritin, D-dimer, LDH, CRP, INR, and alkaline phosphatase, with low total protein and CO₂. Arterial blood gas indicates severe acidosis (pH 6.8), hypoxemia, and low O₂ saturation. These findings suggest severe systemic inflammation, possible sepsis or hematologic disorder, and multi-organ dysfunction. Immediate clinical evaluation is urgently recommended.
